import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int mod;
    static int maxN = 100000;
    static int[] factorial = new int[maxN + 1];
    static int[] invFactorial = new int[maxN + 1];
    static int[] invNum = new int[maxN + 1];

    static class Point {
        int f, g;
        Point(int f, int g) {
            this.f = f;
            this.g = g;
        }
        Point() {
            this.f = 0;
            this.g = 0;
        }
        Point add(Point other) {
            return new Point(addMod(this.f + other.f), addMod(this.g + other.g));
        }
        Point multiply(Point other) {
            long newF = ((long)this.f * other.f) % mod;
            long newG = (addMod((long)this.f * other.g % mod + (long)this.g * other.f % mod));
            return new Point((int)newF, (int)newG);
        }
    }

    static int addMod(int x) {
        return x >= mod ? x - mod : x;
    }

    static int subMod(int x) {
        return x < 0 ? x + mod : x;
    }

    static int fastPow(int base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return (int)result;
    }

    static int sumFormula(int x) {
        long val = (long)x * (x + 1) / 2 % mod;
        return (int)val;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        factorial[0] = 1;
        invFactorial[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxN; i++) {
            factorial[i] = (int)(((long)i * factorial[i - 1]) % mod);
            invFactorial[i] = fastPow(factorial[i], mod - 2);
            invNum[i] = fastPow(i, mod - 2);
        }

        Point[] dp = new Point[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            dp[i] = new Point();
        }
        dp[0] = new Point(1, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                Point temp = dp[j - 1].multiply(dp[i - j]);
                long tempG = (long)temp.g * (i + 1) % mod + (long)temp.f * sumFormula(j - 1) + sumFormula(i - j);
                temp.g = addMod((int)(tempG % mod));
                temp.g = (int)((long)temp.g * invNum[i] % mod);
                temp.f = (int)((long)temp.f * (i + 1) % mod * invNum[i] % mod);
                dp[i] = dp[i].add(temp);
            }
        }

        Point[][] prefix = new Point[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                prefix[i][j] = new Point();
            }
        }
        prefix[0][0] = new Point(1, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int limit = Math.min(i, m);
            for (int j = 0; j <= limit; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    prefix[i][j] = dp[i];
                } else {
                    for (int k = 0; k < j && k < i; k++) {
                        Point prod = dp[k].multiply(prefix[i - k - 1][j - k]);
                        prefix[i][j] = prefix[i][j].add(prod);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int answer = (int)((long)prefix[n][m].g * factorial[m] % mod);
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
